services.name: Pioneer Cabin
services.desc: Tucked into the shade of Pioneer Park, just a short walk from the heart of Prineville, the Pioneer Log Cabin Museum offers a rare glimpse into homestead life in the Ochoco Mountains during the late 1800s. Once the family home of William Jasper Wright and Annie Laura Howes, this historic cabin tells a deeply personal-and authentically local-story of early settlement in Crook County. The original cabin stood about 22 miles east of Prineville, along Upper Ochoco Creek on land owned by Hudspeth Land and Livestock.
